questions.prompt: Which approach best supports reliable work with Cancellation and Timeouts?
options: Use await with try/catch, run independent tasks concurrently with bounded concurrency, and make cancellation/retries explicit.
Skip input validation because Node.js applications run on a trusted server.
Assume every supported runtime has identical APIs and scheduling behavior.
Store credentials and production secrets directly in the source file.
questions.answer_key: Use await with try/catch, run independent tasks concurrently with bounded concurrency, and make cancellation/retries explicit.
questions.explanation: Use await with try/catch, run independent tasks concurrently with bounded concurrency, and make cancellation/retries explicit. The example and verification steps should make this practice observable.

questions.prompt: Before relying on a Cancellation and Timeouts implementation, what verification is most useful?
options: Ignore failures so the program continues silently.
Use the same code regardless of documented version differences.
